original_generation_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: completely original Windows app icon concept for GLYPH, a local generator of passwords, PINs, random tokens and encryption keys.
Generate a fresh design from scratch with NO image references. Explore a distinct independent visual identity. A single bold compact symbol centered in a square 1024x1024 canvas with a simple very dark blue-black #0C1018 presentation background and generous margins. Icon longest extent approximately 66–72% of canvas. Prioritize a strong recognizable silhouette at 24px, few large details and generous negative spaces.
Only one app symbol. No GLYPH wordmark, captions, numbers, watermark or mockup. No conventional shield or padlock illustration, no busy circuitry, no tiny code text. No diagonal slashing, split eraser silhouette, cut lozenge, lightning bolt or heavy white angular shard logo. Do not default to monochrome: follow the individual art direction's palette and medium. No enclosing tile floating inside the canvas.
Direction 04 — PIXEL / digital glyph.
Create an original bold custom pixel glyph built on a strict small 7-by-7 square-pixel grid. Exactly TWO chunky stair-stepped interlocking polyomino masses create a compact almost-square symbol with one simple dark square aperture near its center. The two masses are distinct flat colors: vivid fresh lime #B9F56A and icy mint #66E2CF. Use large consistent square modules and a clearly readable stepped silhouette; no diagonal edges and no antialias-like bevels on the square construction. It should feel like one invented memorable character from a new digital alphabet, not a QR code, random mosaic, Tetris screenshot, checkerboard, known letter or numeral. Only two connected geometric masses and one or two wide black gaps. Clean modern pixel branding, not distressed retro texture or tiny pixel art scene. No surrounding square border and no printed text.
